onMiss: Work in auto-sns-agent and read the flagged items. Down, slow or SSR timeouts: read the tail of .cache/pm2-dev/logs/virev-demo-error.log, restart virev-demo once with `PM2_HOME=.cache/pm2-dev node_modules/.bin/pm2 restart virev-demo`, then GET /health again. Memory or guard restarts: carry on p86 (data in apps/llm-wiki/content/sessions/2026/10/12/1612-virev-demo-vite-memory/data/) and send the readings to ops guy. Walk missing, stale or failed: once /health answers, run the walk behind the load gate: in apps/virev-demo, `PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_FILE=$PWD/../../.cache/duties/virev-demo-offline.json ../../node_modules/.bin/playwright test tests/e2e/offline.spec.ts --reporter=json`. Outside requests: fix the leak in apps/virev-demo so the fake database answers. Fixes are one commit on the local sieun/dev tip under the VP of CI git rules. Never deploy to staging or prod, never move anything to 5174. Tell the owner only when 5180 is down over an hour. All on target: no message.
